remarks: Welcome to this stunning 5-bedroom Colonial home located in the highly sought-after North Stamford neighborhood. Nestled on a spacious one-acre lot, this beautiful residence offers a perfect blend of elegance and comfort.  The main level features an inviting eat-in kitchen, ideal for casual dining and entertaining. The family room, complete with a cozy fireplace, provides a warm and inviting space for relaxation.  The finished basement is a true entertainment hub, boasting a game room, a full bathroom, and a media room, making it an ideal space for family gatherings and movie nights.  With 3.1 bathrooms, this home ensures convenience and privacy for all residents. Don't miss the opportunity to make this exceptional property your new home in North Stamford.
